title: Places Around Me & Double Letters

scenes.t: {name} reads about Youssef. Youssef left his house early in the morning.
First, he went to the library to read a book.
Then, he and his mom went shopping at the supermarket.
They passed the train station and saw a big train.
After lunch, they visited the museum.
In the afternoon, they played at the park. What a fun and busy day!
After a short vowel, we often double f, l, s, z at the end: cuff, bell, tell, miss, grass, buzz, jazz.

activities.title: Memory Game
activities.prompt: Match the question with the place.
pairs: Where do you play with friends?
Where do you see old things?
Where do you take a train?

activities.title: ff, ll, ss or zz?
activities.prompt: Which double letters end the word?

items.q: Who did Youssef go to the supermarket with?
What did Youssef see at the train station?
Where did Youssef go after lunch?
Was Youssef's day busy or boring?

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 44–49
